{{Top|leg}}
A '''hatch cracker''' was a device used to crack the encryption of a security code placed on a hatch. When plugged into a hatch, the possible numbers of a security code would flash along the hatch cracker's surface. If a hatch cracker failed to enter the correct code, a user would press a few buttons to input a different formula.

When attempting to board the [[Junker (YT-2400 light freighter)|''Blackstar'']], a modified [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] belonging to the criminal [[Reegas Vance]], [[Khedryn Faal]] and [[Marr Idi-Shael]] used a hatch cracker to enter through one of the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] external [[Airlock/Legends|airlocks]].<ref name="A Fair Trade">{{InsiderCite|129|A Fair Trade}}</ref>
